trip: Nov 25 to Dec 8, 2024, solo: Mexico City Nov 26-29 (Teotihuacán, Roma Norte, lucha libre, the markets), bus to Puebla, Puebla Nov 29-Dec 2 with a Cholula day trip, Oaxaca Dec 2-6 (food tour, Hierve el Agua and mezcal, Monte Albán), Puerto Escondido Dec 6-8 (surf beach, turtle release)

albums.Mexico (2024): Nov 25 to Dec 8, 2024 by capture date: Mexico City Nov 26-29, Puebla and Cholula Nov 29-Dec 2, Oaxaca Dec 2-6, Puerto Escondido Dec 6-8; check GPS

pages.note: HTML from the Guatemala pre-photo template; 2 weeks in the route-map order: Mexico City 4-5 > Puebla 2-3 (Cholula) > Oaxaca 4 > Puerto Escondido 2-3; he did it in 13 days; Guanajuato/San Miguel, Chiapas, the Yucatán as 'if you have more time' (he has not been)

Nov 26-29: neighborhoods (Roma Norte, Condesa, Polanco, Coyoacán), Teotihuacán, Chapultepec, Bellas Artes, Xochimilco, lucha libre, the markets, where to eat/drink/stay (Wanderlust District); places the journal doesn't have him at are advice

Nov 29-Dec 2: the Zócalo, the walking tour, Biblioteca Palafoxiana, the tunnels, Loreto Fort, the Serdán house, the churches, `## Day Trip to Cholula {#cholula}` (Dec 1 tour), cemitas, tacos árabes, mole, chalupas, Casa Pepe hostel; no city map in the field notes

Dec 2-6: the food tour (the top thing), Santo Domingo, Hierve el Agua and the mezcal distillery, Monte Albán, the mirador at sunset, the markets and restaurants, Casa Angel hostel; the bus/van to Puerto Escondido told in puerto-escondido.md
Dec 6-8: the ride from Oaxaca, Zicatela and La Punta, the baby turtle release, Fish Shack, Ola Taquería, Malagua Café, nightlife, Viajero hostel; flying home from there
